articles.title: Rentosertib moves into Phase III development
articles.summary: Insilico reports AI involvement in both target discovery and molecule design, and announced Phase III development in 2026.
articles.context: Rentosertib is investigational. This development update is not a marketing approval or evidence of a cure.
